afirmacao.enunciado: O UniProt/Swiss-Prot (Tox-Prot) anota função para Snake venom metalloproteinase BthMP de Bothrops moojeni.
afirmacao.passagem: Snake venom zinc metalloproteinase with high proteolytic activity on fibrin and fibrinogen (the alpha chain (FGA) is completely degraded, the beta chain (FGB) is partially degraded, while the gamma chain is not degraded) (PubMed:19000915). Inhibits cell adhesion to fibronectin and collagen IV (PubMed:41901275). In vivo, intramuscular injection induces weak hemorrhage, edema, blood incoagulability, myonecrosis, and leukocyte infiltration. Hemorrhage likely results from basement membrane degradation, while incoagulability may be due to fibrinogen breakdown (PubMed:19000915)
afirmacao.metodo: Evidência experimental publicada (ECO:0000269)
